title: "Script Libraries and Sourcing"

# Script Libraries and Sourcing

Modular scripts reuse libraries using `source` or `.`. Prevent multiple inclusions using header guards:

```bash
# lib/logger.sh
[[ -n "${_LIB_LOGGER_SH:-}" ]] && return 0
readonly _LIB_LOGGER_SH=1

log_info() {
    printf '[%s] [INFO] %s\n' "$(date +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')" "$*" >&2
}
```

Locate libraries reliably relative to the executing script:

```bash
# Locate directory containing this script
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../lib/logger.sh"
```
